apps.name: BT Log
apps.subtitle: Body Transformation Basics tracker
apps.localizedDescription: A personal tracker for Calimove's Body Transformation Basics: sessions in order on the days that suit you, test-week variations, rep logs, course links, and a rest timer that alerts with the screen locked.
apps.versionDescription: First release: the Body Transformation Basics prep phase as 15 sessions you do in order, on any days, with the next session's earliest date. Test-week variations carry into the workouts, every session logs reps and a note, each day and exercise links to the course, and the rest timer alerts with the screen locked.
